about.heading: About Me
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Gee Chai — a Frontend Developer based in Japan passionate about building clean, fast, and user-friendly web applications.
about.paragraph2: I specialize in Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I enjoy turning complex problems into simple, beautiful interfaces that people love to use.
about.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, I'm learning something new — either Japanese and the latest development in technology.
